description: NaVCSO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.71 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.12 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.24-1.36 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-43°. There are two shorter (1.48 Å) and two longer (1.49 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one V, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one S atom.
